title: Neighborhood Cleanup Starter Kit for the Riverside Path
description: We are organizing four low-pressure weekend cleanup sessions for the riverside walking path where plastic bottles, snack wrappers, and drink cans collect near the benches. The raised points will cover reusable gloves, labeled sorting signs, grabbers, and thick collection bags so volunteers can separate recyclables on site instead of treating everything as mixed trash. The goal is to make it easier for first-time volunteers to show up, help for one hour, and leave the area visibly cleaner.
